content:
sam_sales: Heads-up 9: LaunchPad Labs (YC S21) inbound - asking for a 6-week POC with an 'early adopter sponsorship'. They want $25k in promotional credits now + 120h of SE time for onboarding. In return they'd sign a 6-month commitment for $30k. Thoughts?
emily_revops: Need quick usage numbers and a conversion estimate to build the ROI case. Also: do they qualify for our standard startup program or is this an exception?
sam_sales: They're slightly over our typical startup threshold (raised pre-seed + some revenue), so this is an exception. Usage estimate: approx 3M total tokens over 6w, bursty nightly embedding rebuilds, ~1k RT calls/day. If POC converts, conservative ARR $50k in 12mo.
raj_prod: Tech questions: what model(s) are they planning to use? Chat latency + embeddings are core. If index rebuilds are heavy we might need dedicated capacity during onboarding.
ben_infra: Hosted can absorb moderate bursts but long embedding rebuilds will hit throughput. If they sign the $30k commit we can reserve a short Dedicated window for onboarding. Capacity-wise OK. Any infra concessions need deal-desk approval.
laura_security: They submitted a security questionnaire. No SOC2 yet; ISO27001 in progress. If we provide any Private/VPC access, we need stricter controls. For Hosted onboarding we should require customer-managed KMS or log redaction and limit retention to 7 days. Also need named user list for SE access.
sam_sales: They agree to KMS + 7d log retention and an NDA. I'll request the developer list. Questionnaire link: https://internal.docs/launchpad-sq (placeholder).
emily_revops: RevOps checklist to approve credits: (1) written business justification (ARR estimate + conversion prob), (2) signed commit language, (3) SOW for SE hours + deliverables, (4) clawback clause for churn under 90 days. Can you draft a short deal summary?
sam_sales: Deal summary: customer=LaunchPad Labs; POC=6w; Ask=$25k promo credits now + 120h SE; Offer we propose: $25k credits applied on receipt of signed 6mo $30k MRC commit, 10% overage discount, SE hours billed against credits, credits clawed back pro rata if churn <90d.
dealbot: @sam_sales  Please open an approval request: /deal-request create --customer "LaunchPad Labs" --credits 25000 --commit 30000 --term 6m --se-hours 120. Approvers required: emily_revops, laura_security, finance. Attach SOW + SQ.
laura_security: If they later request Private deployment that's a different path (security + infra + legal). For now Hosted + KMS + redaction is acceptable for provisional approval pending SQ review.
ben_infra: To reduce cost during embedding rebuilds we can suggest using quantized weights and larger batch sizes for offline jobs. I'll provide a minimal config snippet for onboarding.
raj_prod: I need a technical artifact pack before I sign off: sample prompts, token length distributions, embedding dims & index type, p95 latency SLOs. Sam can you collect those?
sam_sales: Will fetch prompts & SLOs by EOD.
emily_revops: Finance: @finance, can someone sign off on $25k promo impact and the clawback language? We prefer credits applied after commit to mitigate burn.
finance: Quick check  We prefer to apply credits as a billing credit after the contract is executed. If sales insists on fronting credits, we need a ledger entry and exec approval. Clawback language approved in principle.
oliver_ce: Recommend an incentive: add a "conversion bonus" - extra 10% credit if they reach $60k ARR in 12 months. Makes conversion more likely.
emily_revops: That works if finance agrees to the redemption mechanics. Also require the SE SOW to specify deliverables and acceptance criteria.
laura_security: I'll finish the SQ review this afternoon. If they accept KMS + 7d logs + named SE access, I can provisionally approve security.
ben_infra: Drafting quantization/config snippet and a short onboarding plan; will post here.
sam_sales: Great. Plan: I'll open the deal-request with dealbot, attach SOW + SQ, get the named list, and push contract addendum with clawback + conversion bonus option. Target: sign & start onboarding next week if approvals complete. :rocket:
